name: No Hard-Coded Expected Values
task: Write a test that verifies the cart badge accurately reflects the number of products added. Test with multiple products. Use https://www.saucedemo.com with standard_user / secret_sauce
passCriteria: Test dynamically tracks how many products were added
Badge count is extracted from page element after each addition
Assertion compares extracted badge count to tracked count
Test would fail if badge showed wrong count
No hard-coded expected values like expect(count).toBe(3) without dynamic tracking
failCriteria: Uses expect(true).toBe(true) after clicking add buttons
Tests pass even if badge shows wrong count
Badge count assumed rather than extracted from DOM
evaluationNotes: The agent should track additions dynamically and verify badge matches. Key anti-pattern: hard-coding the expected count without deriving it from what was actually added.
